problems: The Elenchus list is a two-column OCR with a detached number block: the rows 'Notitia altera ex Fabric. Harles' and 'Petrus Possinus Lectori' appear under Theoleptus in the OCR but the Ordo and body place them under Pachymeres (cols 421, 437), so I entered them under Pachymeres; the Elenchus order of the Pachymeres block is thereby the Ordo's order. The Elenchus prints a column only for 381, 407 (as '&07'), 435, 443 and 1217.
Page numbers for many pages were counted from the last explicit header because the OCR lost them (Praefatio 9, Notitia of Theoleptus 379, Possinus Lectori 437, Historia 443, Observationes 995).
Ordo digits are heavily garbled; where Ordo and body differ I trust the body header chain (Allatio notitia 401 vs 407; Dedicatio 458 vs 435; Observationes 993 vs 995).

Omitted editorial matter not in the Elenchus: the editors' Elenchus Caesarum and Elenchus Patriarcharum (lines 105610-105863, col ≈1340-1360), and the Index in Ephraemium (line 106019 on). Ordo-only works: none.
Parts for Observationes and the Appendix are Ordo-only readings, not body-confirmed.
